An older topic we haven't discussed recently:

Imgur is massive. When I follow a link there from Voat, I sometimes cruise around and bring a few things back with me. When I post these pics or gifs, I tend to get a cold response. Some of my favorites even end up with net downvoats. This is fine, because I got my enjoyment from it, so if nobody else enjoys it at least I tried.

But recently, Voat has been inundated with shills. v/Gaming just [issued a meta](https://voat.co/v/gaming/comments/807055) "fuck you" to shameless advertisers, and the entire front page of v/pics is dominated by dozens of accounts less than a month old, presumably imgur bots.

Now, I'd gladly stop using imgur altogether, but SLiMG is light on content right now. It's just not fun to hang out there, because whatever I see on SLiMG I've already seen on Voat. However, when I bring cool stuff back to Voat directly from imgur, I'm downvoated like a shill and told to go back to Reddit (even though the only time I've been back since June was to delete my account).

That said:

* Do we start cutting/pasting imgur content to SLiMG and *then* post it to Voat?

* Do we just cruise the internet and post on SLiMG whatever we find even remotely amusing?

* Do we encourage more *Discuss* posts over *Share a Link*?

On some level, we have to admit that there is good content on imgur, and we need to decide how that content makes its way here.

Unlike some users, I don't split my time between Voat and Reddit. I'm here 100% of the time, and since I've blocked 50+ bigoted, NSFW, or otherwise distasteful subs, I sometimes Voat myself into a corner and have nothing else interesting to click on.

2016 is a [Year of Principle](https://voat.co/v/MeanwhileOnReddit/comments/743319) for me, and I think we should all move forward together in the right direction on this issue.
